task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of flight AA100, prepare the flight request for Jordan Lee in business class, then look up its gate board information and send me a high-priority app notice about that gate update. After that, book AA100 for Jordan Lee in business class, check the details for Hilton Tokyo, get travel-category recommendations related to p_sony_xm5_blk for u_alice, look up AAPL stock info, and then create and send a high-priority app booking summary document for u_alice with the flight confirmation details.

user_input.query: Please check the status of flight AA100, prepare a business class flight request for Jordan Lee, then look up the gate board information for AA100 and send me a high priority app notice about any gate update on the app channel. After that, book AA100 for Jordan Lee in business class, check the details for Hilton Tokyo, and get travel recommendations for user u_alice related to product category travel and product p_sony_xm5_blk. Also look up AAPL stock info, then create and send a high priority app booking summary document on the app channel for u_alice titled Business Trip Booking Summary, including the flight confirmation details.
